scope: Fidelity to the supplied review-comment corpus, full row accounting, exact evidence, retained technical associations/conditions, questions/corrections, and usable skill routing/retrieval.
review_configuration: Three separately tasked agents performed extraction and independent cross-review using the session model configuration, followed by primary review. This was not a multi-model panel.

rounds.process: Independent review, concrete objections, extractor repairs, independent repair recheck.

findings.title: Explicit source-scoped technical requests/questions are excluded solely with supporting-context status
findings.problem: These comments already name an action, type, field, configuration, component, or precise target package. Lack of a hunk limits identification of the old symbol but does not erase the stated technical action/question. They are absent from the case catalog and topic routing, so ordinary symbol search without --include-context misses them. This is narrower than requesting all terse or formatting-only excluded rows be promoted.
findings.requested_repair: Promote these 18 rows to individual records using their literal source wording and path/PR scope. Keep question/suggestion stance where stated; add a no-hunk/unspecified-old-symbol caveat rather than inventing the old target. In particular row1127 FUNDING_METHOD and row1389 akka-cluster.conf remain unresolved questions, row733 proposes increasing errorCountThreshold without supplying a new number, row888 explicitly adds communication to the release service list, and row1496 corrects FeeChargeRequestJdbcProjection to V6 only in the PR-description table. Keep stable row-based A2 IDs and update coverage/provenance/topic outputs after merge.
findings.resolution: All18 specified rows now have stable A2 row-derived IDs, exact comment evidence, source-scoped wording, and explicit no-hunk/uncertainty caveats. New questions remain open; no threshold number, runtime V6 migration, or mandatory package policy invented.

rounds.process: Independent review, concrete objections, extractor repairs, independent repair recheck.

findings.title: Fee/voucher/tax response was flattened and lost account-local calculation conditions
findings.issue: requested_change deduplicates selected field lines into one unstructured list. This loses which accumulatedFee, voucherCode/discount, planCcy and averageFeeRatio belong to each plan and omits calculationTarget=DiscountedPrice entirely. The constraint says tax calculations remain, but the preserved values no longer encode those calculations. This is a substantive loss in an explicitly numeric fee simulation example.
findings.proposed_repair: Retain a compact per-plan structured matrix for all eight original branches, keeping account type+planCcy+averageFeeRatio+accumulatedFee+each voucherCode/discount+DiscountedPrice base+8% tax+total. Omit customer/goal/plan UUIDs. Add the eight exact safe source spans below (or equivalently restore the JSON with incidental IDs removed); do not globally deduplicate field lines.
findings.resolution: Repair inspected in final artifact against the raw source and exact evidence.

findings.title: Fee-withdrawal verification claims four events but does not quote their names; balance caveat is separate
findings.issue: A3-0505 constraint claims four events and a recalculated balance. Its retained evidence contains only the prose heading Events, not the four event names. The next source row explicitly says the balance was messed up by test setup and only an attempted recalculation is established.
findings.proposed_repair: Add exact event-list evidence: CashReservationDeletedEvt, BrokerAccountCashBalanceUpdatedEvt, BrokerAccountWithdrawalRequestUpdatedEvt, CashWithdrawalRequestDeletedEvt. Link row2342 and qualify the constraint as emitted balance-update event/attempted recalculation, not validated balance arithmetic.
findings.resolution: Repair inspected in final artifact against the raw source and exact evidence.

findings.title: Docker smoke test drops technical label/env/build-info keys while claiming them verified
findings.issue: All fenced blocks are omitted. The remaining prose says Correct labels/Correct env var/Expected image layers but no longer identifies GIT_BRANCH_NAME, SHORT_GIT_HASH, /config/info/build, git-branch-name or short-git-hash. The constraint claims branch/hash and layer-order verification without preserving those technical distinctions.
findings.proposed_repair: Keep concise exact snippets for the two Docker label keys, two environment keys, build-info endpoint and JSON key names. Preserve the meaningful relative layer sequence (CMD/ENTRYPOINT/USER, app branch/hash env+labels, three COPY layers, WORKDIR/user creation, microdnf base update) if continuing to claim layer-order verification; registry/project/pod/hash values can remain omitted. Alternatively narrow the constraint to the limited prose claim instead of implying retained layer details.
findings.resolution: Repair inspected in final artifact against the raw source and exact evidence.

findings.title: New-model subscriber release target correction is absent from the preceding record
findings.issue: Row2854 is retained only as supporting context. A3-0993 at2853 asks for new-model subscriber validation and services.list/release but has no clarification that the target is redemption service rather than transaction service. The exact service correction is a substantive scope qualifier in the same PR.
findings.proposed_repair: Append a constraint to the2853 record referencing2854: the commenter corrects service target to redemption, not transaction. Add2854 exact evidence and keep its ledger supporting disposition if no separate pattern is needed.
findings.resolution: Repair inspected in final artifact against the raw source and exact evidence.

findings.title: Withdrawn grouping question remains an unqualified open question
findings.issue: The grouping question at2872 remains open-question with no revision qualifier. Adjacent same-PR/file row2873 says Nvm minor thing and is excluded as acknowledgement; this withdrawal is not visible on the pattern.
findings.proposed_repair: Add a related-row constraint that2873 withdraws/sets aside the grouping question as minor. Preserve original question as historical, but do not expose it as an outstanding requested grouping change.
findings.resolution: Repair inspected in final artifact against the raw source and exact evidence.

findings.title: HK detail is sourced only from PR title but lacks PR-title evidence attribution
findings.issue: The custom constraint calls the test an HK plan. The prose never says HK; the PR title does, and no hunk is available. Evidence contains only comment quotes, so the added region detail lacks the required context_field=pr_title traceability.
findings.proposed_repair: Add exact context_quote/context_field=pr_title evidence for2480 and explicitly identify HK as metadata-derived. Consider the same simple PR-title evidence addition for all records whose authored title/constraints derive details from PR metadata.
findings.resolution: Repair inspected in final artifact against the raw source and exact evidence.

findings.title: Source test says88 days while JSON says90; preserve visible inconsistency
findings.issue: Both values remain in requested_change, so there is no literal omission. However the source is internally inconsistent: its rough formula uses88days while totalHoldingPeriodInDays is90. This matters when presenting the report as fee-calculation verification.
findings.proposed_repair: Add a constraint noting the source88-vs90 discrepancy and avoid treating the rough formula as independently verified exact fee arithmetic. Do not silently change either value.
findings.resolution: Repair inspected in final artifact against the raw source and exact evidence.

rounds.process: Independent review, concrete objections, extractor repairs, independent repair recheck.

findings.title: Flattened migration-test field lists lose before/after and nested event roles
findings.issue: Four transformed records preserve individual literal lines but discard Existing entity data versus after-script section labels and parent fields such as currentTaa/newTaa, previousProductLineAndIntent/newProductLineAndIntent and previousProductLine/newProductLine. Goal emits multiple similarly named events, so the unstructured sequence no longer preserves which old/new values belong to each event. The shared d56-versus-prod/name caveats are also omitted.
findings.proposed_repair: Retain coherent identity-free before-state, after-state and per-event structures for goal/rebalance/trading/charge, with explicit section labels and enclosing old/new keys. Preserve all meaningful technical field/value associations and repeated event branches; IDs and unrelated verbose metadata may be omitted. Carry the source d56 effective-date difference and goal-name caveat.

findings.title: Standalone client example drops technical discovery configuration
findings.issue: The transformed record omits the complete configuration tail. This removes ENV/REGION selection, the remote-client-discovery include and SERVICES_DOMAIN key, even though the title claims a configuration example. Empty credential placeholders and the literal environment host can remain omitted.
findings.proposed_repair: Add exact safe configuration snippets identifying application.overrides.conf, ENV/REGION, include local/client-discovery.remote.conf and the SERVICES_DOMAIN key, with explicit omission of host/credential values. Do not imply the Scala code alone is the entire supplied setup.

findings.title: Exact title fields inferred from hunks need retained attribution;380 uses the wrong field spelling
findings.issue: Titles add transactionFee, lastUpdated, requestBy/reason and cashOnlyFee although those exact code fields appear only in the available raw hunks, not in the comment text. Their records have PR-title metadata but no hunk evidence.380 actual field is lastUpdatedAt, not lastUpdated.
findings.proposed_repair: Add a concise exact hunk span and explicit hunk-only field-identification constraint, or keep titles descriptive rather than naming unquoted code fields. Correct380 to lastUpdatedAt if using the exact field name.

findings.title: Title invents a qualified-topic shorthand and silently repairs a source package spelling
findings.issue: 974 title SgCustomerServiceComplianceTopic is not the actual symbol; source says SgCustomerServiceTopics.CustomerServiceComplianceTopic.1216 title silently changes source sgPlanAcknowlegdement to sgPlanAcknowledgement. Full requested statements preserve the source, but exact-symbol retrieval through titles can be misleading.
findings.proposed_repair: Use the exact qualified topic symbol or descriptive wording. For1216 preserve the source spelling with an explicit note, or use a descriptive SG-specific-package title rather than silently asserting a corrected code symbol.

findings.title: Titles assign exact unnamed targets without available hunk support
findings.issue: The respective comments do not name getTenantRingfencingProfile, priceSource or commId, and raw hunks are unavailable. These titles supply precise targets beyond their own retained evidence.399 may be corroborated by same-PR423; the other two should retain target uncertainty rather than invent an exact symbol.
findings.proposed_repair: Use descriptive source-level titles or append exact same-thread supporting evidence with a qualified relationship. Do not turn here/this/these into a definite code target without evidence.

findings.title: Selected driver-code lines omit the TypesafeDriverConfig guard
findings.issue: The prose correctly scopes the cloud/default override, but the selected code inventory retains productType and overrideDefaults while dropping the explicit driverConfig instanceof TypesafeDriverConfig guard. That is a meaningful condition in the quoted implementation.
findings.proposed_repair: Retain the short coherent DriverConfig/TypesafeDriverConfig/cloud-product conditional block, or explicitly state that omitted code also requires TypesafeDriverConfig. Keep defaultLOCAL_QUORUM versus akka-projectionQUORUM profile associations unchanged.

findings.title: Deletion case should preserve dividend preference discriminator and source naming discrepancy
findings.issue: A1-2109 title says DistributeCashBalance, while retained prose says DistributedCashBalance. The actual raw JSON discriminator is distributionPreference=DistributeCashBalance but that field is omitted by the selected-line filter. This matters because the source specifically conditions deletion/retry on this preference.
findings.proposed_repair: Retain the exact distributionPreference field and note source prose DistributedCashBalance versus JSON DistributeCashBalance spelling rather than silently resolving the discrepancy. No need to restore account/customer identifiers or full payload logs.
